title: Cup of hot cocoa with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='cocoa' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#8B4513'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#5C2E0A'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='cup' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FF6B6B'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#CC3333'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='steam' x1='0' y1='1' x2='0' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE4B5' stop-opacity='0.7'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFE4B5' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Steam wisps -->
  <path d='M38 28 Q34 22 38 16 Q42 10 38 4' stroke='#FFE4B5' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M50 26 Q46 19 50 13 Q54 7 50 1' stroke='#FFE4B5' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M62 28 Q58 22 62 16 Q66 10 62 4' stroke='#FFE4B5' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Saucer -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='34' ry='7' fill='#FFB347'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='34' ry='7' fill='#FFD280'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='79' rx='30' ry='5' fill='#FFC04D'/>

  <!-- Cup body -->
  <path d='M24 38 L28 78 Q50 86 72 78 L76 38 Z' fill='url(#cup)'/>
  <!-- Cup rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='26' ry='7' fill='#FF8888'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='26' ry='7' fill='none' stroke='#FFAAAA' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- Cocoa surface -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='22' ry='5.5' fill='url(#cocoa)'/>
  <!-- Cocoa highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='38' rx='8' ry='2.5' fill='#A0522D' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Handle -->
  <path d='M76 48 Q92 48 92 60 Q92 72 76 70' fill='none' stroke='#CC3333' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M76 48 Q90 48 90 60 Q90 70 76 68' fill='none' stroke='#FF8888' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Smiling face on cup -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='56' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#FFE4B5'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='56' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#FFE4B5'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='55' rx='2' ry='2.5' fill='#5C2E0A'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='55' rx='2' ry='2.5' fill='#5C2E0A'/>
  <!-- Eye sparkle -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='54' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='54' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>

  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M42 64 Q50 72 58 64' fill='none' stroke='#FFE4B5' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Blush -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='62' rx='3.5' ry='2' fill='#FF9999' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='62' rx='3.5' ry='2' fill='#FF9999' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Cocoa drip on rim -->
  <path d='M36 38 Q37 43 39 42' stroke='#5C2E0A' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 38 Q59 44 61 43' stroke='#5C2E0A' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Mini marshmallows -->
  <rect x='42' y='36' width='5' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#FFFACD'/>
  <rect x='55' y='35' width='5' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#FFFACD'/>
  <rect x='49' y='34' width='4' height='3.5' rx='1.2' fill='#FFF8DC'/>
</svg>
